text:
Alex M: ran overnight quant bakeoff for mistral-7b variants (fp16 / gptq-int8 / awq-int8 / fp8-trt). quick summary: AWQ-int8 on A100 (CUDA 12.1) shows ~1.8% rouge-l drop vs fp16 on our eval set, GPTQ-int8 is ~0.6% down, FP8 on TensorRT gives slightly better quality (+0.2%) but hits runtime/driver failures on A100 PCIe. T4 with CUDA 11.8 runs AWQ fine. :thinking:

Rachael: can you paste the exact runtime stack + command you ran? want to reproduce locally. :eyes:

Alex M: sure — main configs below. note we run both TRT-LLM path and vLLM path as separate drivers for throughput comparison.

```
# run-bakeoff.sh (trimmed)
TRT_IMAGE=tensorrt-llm:2.1.0
docker run --gpus all --rm -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \n  -v /mnt/models:/models $TRT_IMAGE \n  trtllm_server --model /models/mistral-7b --quant awq-int8 --batch 4 --max-seq 2048
\n# vLLM run for comparison
python run_vllm.py --model /models/mistral-7b --quant gptq --batch 4 --max_seq_len 2048
```

Alex M: relevant log snippets (A100, CUDA12.1):
```
[trtllm] ERROR: kernel launch failed: CUBLAS_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR
[trtllm] Fallback: trying cublasLt matmul
[trtllm] ERROR: fp8 kernel unsupported instruction on this GPU/driver
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

Rachael: ugh. segfault + cublas internal. any deterministic divergence in outputs or just crash?

Alex M: both. for AWQ path we see token-level divergence starting at step 12 vs fp16 golden run (same prompt, same random seed). For FP8 path using TRT we get correct tokens up to ~80 tokens then kernel OOB or segfault. On T4 (CUDA11.8) AWQ/int8 runs to completion and quality delta matches local microbenchmarks. So it's largely a driver+kernel mismatch on 12.x + A100.

Devon: did you try toggling cuBLAS/workspace or using CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG? we had a similar cublasLt mismatch earlier with mixed tensor alignments. Also try setting CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to see first failing kernel.

Alex M: tried CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=4096:8 and CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 — got identical internal error, but traced the failing call to attention GEMM in trt kernel. Also saw a nvrtc JIT warning about unsupported fma8 intrinsics in the kernel build.

Matt: could be mismatched TRT-LLM build flags vs CUDA toolkit. Which tensorRT/cuBLAS versions are in the container?

Alex M: TRT 8.6 with our trt-llm 2.1.0 image, cuBLAS from CUDA 12.1 runtime. Container was built against 12.1 headers. The odd thing: FP8 kernel path checks for architecture compute capability and we have sm_80, but it still hits the "unsupported fp8 instruction" code path. Suspect a libnvrtc or driver ABI difference between host driver (530.x) and container runtime.

Rachael: any workaround to keep AWQ quality without crashing? fallback to gptq kernels maybe?

Alex M: workaround: force TRT to use int8-gptq-like kernels by setting env var TRT_FORCE_INT8_FALLBACK=1 or just use the vLLM path (slower) — that avoids segfaults but throughput drops ~30-40%. Also repro script to reproduce divergence is small: run same seed with batch=1, prompt length 64 — divergence replicates quickly.

Devon: file a vendor ticket with minimal repro including container+driver versions and the small prompt script. I can try rebuilding trt-llm with nvrtc from CUDA11.8 toolchain and see if the jit flags differ.

InfraBot: created INF-2847: "trt-llm fp8/awq kernel failures on A100 CUDA12" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2847

Matt: also try disabling fused attention kernels (set TRTL_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1) — that at least forces the ref path and might reveal if it's attention-specific.

Alex M: tried that; with fused attention disabled we still hit cublas internal error but it's later. So probably several optimized kernels affected. Also noticed that enabling deterministic math (export TF32_OVERRIDE=0) changes divergence point but doesn't eliminate it.

Rachael: ok. what do you need from eng-infra / vendor to unblock?

Alex M: short-term: infra help to spin up a clean node with driver 525.x and CUDA 11.8 runtime to reproduce baseline that works (we have some machines but need one reproducible host/container pairing). Long-term: vendor bug — need a reproducible C++ repro and trace logs (cublasLt API calls + kernel params). I can attach the small script and perf traces to INF-2847.

Devon: I'll try a local rebuild with nvrtc pinned to 11.8 and drop-in the trt kernels; if that fixes we can bake a patch in our trt-llm rpm.

Matt: add note: customers using Dedicated/Private may hit this if they upgrade host drivers. we should add a short KB: "AWQ/FP8 incompatibility matrix: recommended driver/toolkit combos". I'll draft one. :memo:

Alex M: final note — for now marking AWQ-on-A100-CUDA12 as experimental and defaulting hosted infra to use GPTQ-int8 or FP16 for A100 until we have vendor fix. I'll update the bakeoff doc with numbers and link INF-2847. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
